items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miyamoto Musashi is a person that Elvin’s wife Keiko would always talk about. Elvin would talk about The Book of Five Rings. I spent a substantial amount of time in Japan with Elvin. I just figured, for the next record I’d pay tribute to Musashi.

ctx.x: “Musasha didn’t show up.” It was kind of jive. There was a number of Japanese students coming in. So we would just – who knew? Finally they caught wind of it, and they were like – I’m sure they knew a lot earlier than they cracked down. They just said, well, whatever. But at a certain point they cracked down on us.
You must have done something right, because you ended up getting your degree from them, right?
